probe.text_sample: Landing - Landscape Back to all News Menu Home Work Profile News Events Contact Modal Establishing the category leader in serverless cloud infrastructure. Valued at $4.65B post redesign, including a $355M series C. Journ Expressing joy in ritual. Launching the natural standard for inclusive skincare. Mindbloom Driving a 50% increase in customer brand trust for the largest at-home ketamine therapy provider. Antora Setting a new standard for industrial heat and power. Thermal energy storage with $230M+ total funding and a $14.5M DOE award. Seed Driving growth for the category leader in probiotic innovation. ~43% YoY revenue growth, targeting $1B+ valuation. Gantri Boosting engagement for a sustainable lighting platform, yielding a 108% increase in product view conversion and 17% increase in order conversion. Variloom Launching an innovation leader in 3D-printed fabrics and materials circularity. Cookma In service of balance and beauty. Accelerating growth and unlocking distribution for a post-partem CPG brand rooted in Ayurvedic wisdom. Giro Spring/Summer '25 Road Cycling launch campaign. Establishing category dominance for a global cycling leader through elevated storytelling. Albed
